question: Which statement regarding the corner point method is correct?
explanation: According to the corner point (vertex) theorem, if an optimal value exists, it will be at a corner point of the feasible region.

options.A: The optimal value always occurs at the center of the feasible region
options.B: The objective function is to be evaluated only at boundary points not intersected by constraints
options.C: The optimal value, if it exists, occurs at a vertex (corner point) of the feasible region
options.D: The objective function is always maximum inside the region and minimum at the boundary
